rules._note: The file stating which level its numbers come from (M-32). ⚠ Three of the four slots matter to the **engine's own** skill execution (its damage rows), and TALENT matters to nothing here yet — it is stated because the entry is a fact about the loadout, and 星魂 3/5 below amend the same counters. Without this, the engine would deal the Lv1 rows (1.4→0.5, 1.2→0.6, 1.6→0.96). ⚠ The crit-rate/talent numbers above are stated literally in this file (they are rules, not rows the engine reads), so they are unaffected by it.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 天赋 崇高的客体 (130204, Enhance): 「施放普攻、战技、终结技时，每击中1个敌方目标，为银枝恢复3点能量并获得1层【升格】，使银枝暴击率提高2.50%，该效果最多叠加10层。」 数据行 Lv10 = [3, 0.025, 10] → #1 = 3 能量、#2 = 0.025、#3 = 10 层
rules._note: The talent, on the 普攻 half of its three slots. ⚠ `per_target: true` is 「**每击中 1 个**敌方目标…恢复 3 点能量」 — the energy multiplies by the event's hit count. ⚠【升格】 is a **stackable named modifier** rather than a separate counter plus a buff: `max_stacks: 10` on the crit-rate modifier gives 「最多叠加10层」 for free, and `buff: 升格` gives the name every other clause needs. ⚠ **`times_from: "hit_count"` is the stack half** (2026-10-31): 「每击中 1 个敌方目标」 grants one layer **per target hit**, so an AoE that hits three grants three. A non-`DAMAGE` effect now repeats on the event's hit count (`EffectTimesTest`), and `ArgentiStacksTest.threeEnemiesGiveThreeStacks` pins 1 hit = 1 layer and 3 hits = 3. ⚠ An earlier probe read 2 layers for a single-target 战技/终结技; it did not reproduce on the same content (both a synthetic table and this file measure 1), so it is recorded as a false reading, not a defect (AGENT §3.7zm CORRECTED). ⚠ The value is her talent row's #2 (Lv10 = 0.025), not a literal somebody typed.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 天赋: 「施放普攻、战技、终结技时…」 之二（战技）
rules._note: The 战技 third of the same sentence — three rules because 「普攻、战技、终结技」 are three cast events, and a rule fires on one. ⚠ They cannot be one rule: [the DSL has no OR], and the events themselves are split at the emitter (see 1215's shock marks for the same shape). ⚠ `times_from: "hit_count"` here for the reason the 普攻 rule states: one layer per enemy hit.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 天赋: 「施放普攻、战技、终结技时…」 之三（终结技）
rules._note: The 终结技 third — see the 普攻 rule for why there are three and for the per-hit count. ⚠ It fires for the **强化终结技** as well in the game (both are the Ultra slot), but this engine only casts 130203: data slot 14 is not in the `SkillType` map, which is registered in `_gaps`. ⚠ The per-hit half is one layer per enemy hit, the same as the 普攻 rule.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 行迹 虔诚 (1302101): 「回合开始时，立即获得1层【升格】。」
rules._note: 「**回合开始时**，立即获得 1 层【升格】」 — `TURN_START` with `actor == self` (the event is delivered to the character whose turn begins; every other table evaluates it with `target` and `actor` other than the owner, so `actor == self` is what keeps it to her own turns). ⚠ The energy half is deliberately absent: this trace grants a stack, not energy.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 行迹 勇气 (1302103): 「对当前生命值百分比小于等于50%的敌方目标造成的伤害提高15%。」
rules._note: 「对**当前生命值百分比小于等于 50% 的**敌方目标造成的伤害提高 15%」. ⚠ `target_hp_percent` is the existing variable that reads the **event's target** — the unit being hit — which is exactly the sentence's subject, so no new vocabulary was needed; `actor == self` keeps it to her damage. ⚠ `BOOST_DAMAGE` raises this instance only, which is 就是「对某类目标造成的伤害」这类条件句的意思. ⚠ This is the first shipped reader of `target_hp_percent` in a *damage* rule (it was added for 1001's shield clause).

rules.source: 1302 银枝 星魂 1 审美王国的缺口 (Avatar_Argenti_00_Rank01): 「每层【升格】额外使暴击伤害提高4%。」 param = [0.04]
rules._note: 「**每层**【升格】额外使暴击伤害提高 4%」 — one stackable crit-damage modifier on the same name and cap as the talent's crit-rate one. ⚠ **This clause is KNOWN WRONG and registered, not papered over** (2026-10-31 measured): the modifier is attached **once at battle start**, so the crit damage is a flat **+0.04** at every stack count, including zero - the sentence says per layer, and 0 layers must give 0. The engine's per-stack arms are the ones that turned out not to line up (see the registration in `_gaps`); the fix is the same shape as the talent's stacks (one modifier re-applied whenever a layer is gained), and `ArgentiStacksTest.herCritDamageDoesNotFollowTheStacks` is the witness that goes red when it lands.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 星魂 2 玛瑙石的谦卑 (Avatar_Argenti_00_Rank02): 「施放终结技时，若敌方目标数量大于等于3个时，攻击力提高40%，持续1回合。」 param = [3, 0.4, 1] → #1 = 3 个、#2 = 0.4、#3 = 1 回合
rules._note: 「**施放终结技时**，若敌方目标数量**大于等于 3 个**时，攻击力提高 40%，持续 1 回合」. ⚠ `CAST_SETUP`, not `ULT_CAST`: the latter fires **after** the ultimate's damage has settled, while the sentence ties the raise to the cast it is used with (the same reason 23039 pays its HP there). ⚠ `enemy_count` is the existing variable (`TriggerTable`'s `enemyCount`, living enemies only) — the earlier note here said "no enemy-count variable", which was true when it was written and is **corrected** by this rule, not by a new word. ⚠ `from_category ULTRA` keeps it to the ultimate. ⚠ `percent` and not `ratio`: ATTACK is a flat attribute and `ratio` is refused for those at load. ⚠ `turns: 1` is 「持续 1 回合」 on the engine's clock: applied during her own turn, it survives to her next turn start.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 星魂 4 号角的奉献 (Avatar_Argenti_00_Rank04): 「战斗开始时，获得2层【升格】，并使天赋的效果可叠加上限提高2层。」 param = [2, 2] + 后半「并使天赋的效果可叠加上限提高2层」（用 `effect_max_stacks: 2` 抬三条天赋规则的上限）
rules._note: 「**战斗开始时，获得 2 层**【升格】」 — two effects because one stack is one buff: stating the same modifier twice at battle start attaches two of them, which is what 「2 层」 means and is the same shape 遗器's stacking bonuses use. ⚠ **Registered, not written**: the second half 「使天赋的效果**可叠加上限提高 2 层**」 would raise a `max_stacks` field on another rule's effect, which is `MODIFY_RULE`'s family but a **fourth** form (it raises a count of firings, a probability, a value and a duration today — not a cap). Filing it as two extra stacks instead would be wrong in the one case that matters: they must be able to exceed 10. ⚠ **2026-09-28 补齐**：后半「使天赋的效果**可叠加上限提高 2 层**」现在写出来了 —— `MODIFY_RULE` 的**第四形态**（`effect_max_stacks: 2`），三条天赋规则各抬一次（一条规则抬一条规则）。⚠ 写成"再补两层"是**错的**：它必须能**超过 10 层**，而补两层仍受 10 层上限约束。⚠ 修正案在战斗开始时就登记，而层数是之后一次次命中才叠上去的，所以新上限**来得及**生效（`max_stacks` 是 buff 实例上的值，事后抬没用）。

rules.source: 1302 银枝 星魂 3 荆棘路的荣光 (Avatar_Argenti_00_Rank03): 「战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。」 数据行 技能等级+{'130202': 2, '130204': 2}
rules._note: 星魂 3's two raises (M-32). ⚠ They compose with the base-level rule by addition (the same arithmetic 1103/1215 use).

rules.source: 1302 银枝 星魂 5 宇宙某处的雪 (Avatar_Argenti_00_Rank05): 「终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。」 数据行 技能等级+{'130203': 2, '130201': 1, '130214': 2}
rules._note: 星魂 5's two raises. ⚠ The data line names **three** skill ids (130203, 130201 and 130214 — the enhanced ultimate too), while the sentence names two slots: the ULTRA raise covers both ultimate ids because a slot is what the engine reads (`SkillType.ULTRA`), which is why the third id needs no rule of its own. ⚠ **已写**：星魂 2（`eidolon2_attack_with_three_enemies`）与星魂 6（下面那条 `DEALING_DAMAGE`）原先记在这里说"写不了"，两条都已在文件里 —— `enemy_count` 与 `DEFENCE_IGNORE` 后来都落地了。⚠ **仍开、已登记在 `_gaps`**：行迹 慷慨「在敌方目标进入战斗时…」（没有敌方入场事件）与强化终结技整段（引擎的施放路径没有数据槽 14，所以「额外 6 次随机单体」与 336% 那一行都放不出来）。

rules.source: 1302 银枝 星魂 6 「你」的光芒 (Avatar_Argenti_00_Rank06): 「施放终结技时，无视敌方目标30%的防御力。」 param = [0.3]
rules._note: 「施放终结技时，无视敌方目标 30% 的防御力」 — the attribute exists (`DEFENCE_IGNORE`) and so does the shape: the buff is granted on `DEALING_DAMAGE` **before** the zones are assembled, so it applies to the very instance it was granted for (the same trick 知更鸟【协奏】的附加伤害 uses). ⚠ `from_skill ULTRA` keeps it to the ultimate (both ultimate ids are that slot) and `actor == self` keeps it to her damage. ⚠ `min_eidolon: 6` is the gate.

rules.source: 1302 银枝 行迹 慷慨: 「在敌方目标进入战斗时，自身立即恢复2点能量。」 param [2]
rules._note: 「在敌方目标进入战斗时，自身立即恢复 2 点能量」—— 事件 **`ENEMY_ENTERED`** ✓（本轮新增：`Battle.addEnemy` / `addCombatant` 把**新加入敌方名册**的单位送进场时发一次，`actor` = 那个新来的 ✓；开战前的名册只是「摆好」，不算入场 ✓）；额度 2 = 行迹数据 `param [2]` ✓。⚠ 同一单位**重复加入**不会重复付账 ✓（幂等判据在引擎侧 ✓）。

rules.source: 1302 银枝 强化终结技 数据槽 14（驻「我」华庭，授予至勋）: 「消耗180点能量…」—— 能量**满**（180/180）时才换上强化行 ✓
rules._note: 能量满 ⇒ `REPLACE_SKILL ULTRA skill_id: 14` ✓（数据槽 14 存在 ✓）；`permanent: true` 让它留在槽上，直到下面的规则在能量不足时摘掉 ✓。

rules.source: 1302 银枝 强化终结技: 施放后能量归零 ⇒ 强化形态必须换回普通行 ✓
rules._note: 施放终结技后把替换摘掉 ✓（`remove: true`，与 1111 的天赋结束同形 ✓）。

_gaps: 每层升格的暴击率（天赋 #2，Lv1 0.01 / Lv10 0.025）**暂时保留字面值**：改成 `percent_from_skill_param: TALENT:1` 后，`ArgentiStacksTest` 的「E4 上限」用例从 0.35 变成 0.38（14 层 ⇒ 预期 0.35），说明改读行后**层数记账变了**（疑似两层同形修饰的合并/身份判定），需要先查清再改；数值本身（0.025）是对的 ✓
